question: Can public authentic donor-matched native EMC tumor/derived-culture assays support a useful unreported fidelity contrast that changes which model/handling condition can represent a tissue-measured tumor-cell program, beyond original identity validation or bulk-mixture differences?
conditional_concrete_comparison: First authenticate at least a real tumor-to-derived-culture donor bridge, comparable assay/capture and handling, all paired specimens/controls and primary prior-art. A future numerical stage must preselect one practical tissue-measured tumor-cell feature or global within-donor fidelity metric and a meaningful same-assay cross-donor/control reference before new values, with purity/composition and culture selection addressed. No feature/statistic chosen from old failed panels or newly observed expression.
source_scope: Reuse verified USZ/V1-34/Brenca/TempO native identity and assay maps plus R8 culture-context records; no broad GEO title search, duplicated source/matrix/FASTQ downloads or failed chemokine/IR/APA/static panels. Source methods, identity, cohort and controls only until a useful exact question receives root approval.
needed_fields: Explicit original native tissue-to-culture donor/specimen/run links, not shared codes/fusion partner alone
All authentic native culture and candidate paired tissues, processing/storage/passage/therapy/source date
Assay/capture/platform/library preparation and public output identifiers, units and compatibility
Tumor percentage/stroma/necrosis/normal compartment and viable malignant-cell ascertainment
Same-donor and comparator handling/medium/passage controls, independent donors versus technical runs
Primary original fidelity/validation conclusions and any useful unanswered measurement decision
strongest_alternatives: Bulk tissue stromal/immune/necrotic admixture versus selected viable cultured cells
Culture medium/passage/clonal selection, processing ischemia and therapy history
FFPE targeted TempO versus bulk RNA-seq, ARCHS4 estimated counts versus RefSeq quantification
Different patients, partner/state/site and unresolved source/donor overlap
Primary already establishes the same model fidelity or expected generic tissue/culture difference
prospective_disproof: No explicit public matched native donor bridge or suitable all-condition outputs
Capture/platform/batch/purity/handling confounds defeat the intended cell-intrinsic interpretation
Contrast already published or merely an expected bulk tissue versus pure culture difference
No consequential model/measurement use beyond generic fidelity visualization or rescoring failed panels
prior_value_exposure_record: Initial reading of the R8 MODEL-CONTEXT metadata file also displayed previously evaluated DLL3/SEZ6/NCAM1 panel values. These are prior verified results, not new analysis; they will not select features/statistics or support a new fidelity result. No new numerical measurements, raw matrix/FASTQ, or chemokine/IR/APA panel analysis is authorized. The source/assay/donor plan remains prospective for every new numerical contrast.
coverage: All relevant authentic public EMC donors/specimens/conditions and uncertain source aliases remain accountable. Native fusion support is not evidence of paired culture origin, lineage fidelity, protein localization or dependence. Suitable pending source metadata blocks promotion; no missing-to-zero or global exhaustion.

operations.restrictions: Original freezes immutable. Denied FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA content unexamined, no bypass/private/logins/spend/GPU/outreach/publication/PR. Root alone main/push; Codex author+committer. Clock immediately before any UI; no images needed for initial metadata review.

goal: Useful EMC evidence remains goal; no new paper is inferred from successful source inventory or failure of an invented hypothesis.
